title: Karbala Ka Marqa
body:
KARBALA KA MARKA YUU SAR KIYA SHABBIR as NE
DEEN KA KASA SARON SE BHAR DIYA SHABBIR NE
______________
SHAHED SE SHEERIn HAI ISKA ZAIQA MERE LIYE
KEH KE YUn JAAM E SHAHADAT PI LIYA SHABBIR NE
_____________
HASHR TAK USKI HIFAZAT KO HAWA MAMOOR HAI
KHOON SE DEEn KA JALAYA JO DIYA SHABBIR NE
_________________
PEHRE PAANI PAR LAGE THE YUn BUJHAI TASHNAGI.
BADH GAYI JAB PYAS ASHKOn KO PIYA SHABBIR NE
_______________
THI YAHI RAB KI RAZA MAOLA as NE UF TAK NA KIYA
SEH GAYA HAR ZULM HONTHO KO SIYA SHABBIR NE
_______________
ZARRE ZARRE KO PILA KAR APNI SHEH RAG KA LAHOO
KAR DIYA SERAAB DASHT E MARIYA SHABBIR NE
_________________
KAT GAI SAJDE ME GARDAN BAIYAT E FASIQ NA KI
ZINDAGI KO YUn USOOLOn PAR JIYA SHABBIR NE
_______________
JABR KA KAATA GALA *JAWAD* TEGH E SABR SE
JANG KO BAKHSHA NAYA YUN ZAAWIYA SHABBIR NE
______________
